text:
Alex: Quick idea — neon nibbles + retro arcade on the patio next Wednesday? Taco cart, mocktail station, and maybe the old NES/arcade console setup from storage. Thoughts? :taco::video_game:
Nina: love this. can we have non-alc mocktails for drivers? :yay:
Omar: I'm down. can bring extension cords and power strip. also we should confirm rooftop permit?
Chen: I can check rooftop schedule. if it's open Wed 6pm works for me.
Riley: I can bring the mini arcade (2-player) if we figure transport. also happy to be point for cleanup.
Alex: @Chen check with facilities on permit & noise curfew. @Riley yay on arcade. @Nina we'll do mocktails + one boozy punch option.
Nina: I'll do a quick shopping list once date is locked. low-sugar options too.
Omar: Budget q: do we ask company to cover tacos + mocktail supplies or split? last time finance covered $300 for similar.
poll-bot: Poll created — Vote for date: 1) Wed 6pm 2) Thu 7pm 3) Sat 4pm
Alex: React with :one::two::three: and add :busts_in_silhouette: if you're bringing someone.
Riley: Sat :three: — earlier on weekend is nicer for me
Chen: Wed :one: — prefer midweek decompress
Nina: Thu :two: — but I can do Wed if needed
Omar: Wed :one: for me. I'll RSVP once calendar event is up.
poll-bot: Current reactions — Wed(3), Thu(1), Sat(1). Wed is leading.
Chen: Facilities says rooftop available but requires a short noise notice to neighbors. I'll submit form.
Alex: Cool. @Omar can you check with finance? If they cover tacos + $50 for mocktail supplies that'd be ideal. Otherwise we do a pay-at-cart model.
Omar: Pinged finance. should hear by EOD.
Riley: One favor — does anyone have a hand truck or dolly to move the arcade? It's ~55 lbs.
Nina: I have a folding hand truck in locker 2. can bring it.
Alex: Perfect. I'll create the event once finance confirms. working title: "Neon Nibbles & Pixel Battles". If finance declines, we'll do pay-at-cart and still proceed.
calendar-bot: Event tentative: "Neon Nibbles & Pixel Battles" Wed 6pm — RSVP opens after approval
Alex: Nice. If anyone wants to bring snacks/games/lanterns drop a message. I'll compile final checklist tomorrow. :sparkles:
